items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you know all of Ellington’s guys, Dicky Wells, wonderful player.

ctx.x: And Jack Jenney. Miff Mole, great, terribly underrated. Then I guess, Tricky Sam, Lawrence Brown, you know all of Ellington’s guys, Dicky Wells, wonderful player.
One of your successors with Jimmy Dorsey, Bobby Byrne.
